description.en: Open the Explorer at Plantae to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开植物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Aglaophyton time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的阿格兰蕨属时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 早期陆生植物证据比较

description.en: Compare Aglaophyton and Horneophyton through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较阿格兰蕨属与角蕨属；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: Zanjón组隐孢子陆生植物锚点

description.en: Open the approximately 473–471 Ma Zanjón Formation cryptospore sample from northwest Argentina in the Plantae map to inspect evidence for embryophytes on emerged land.
description.zh: 在植物地图中打开约473–471 Ma、来自阿根廷西北部Zanjón组的隐孢子样品，检查胚胎植物登上出露陆地的证据。

limitations: The route represents the dated Zanjón Formation palynological sample and does not establish a first appearance for all Plantae, a crown-bryophyte fossil, a complete distribution or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the rounded 335 Ma late Visean moss sample from eastern Germany in the Bryophyta map to inspect the oldest-moss evidence retained by this package.
description.zh: 在苔藓植物地图中打开约335 Ma、来自德国东部晚维宪期地层的苔藓样品，检查本包保留的古老苔藓证据。

limitations: The age is a rounded late Visean sample bound with fragmentary preservation and stage-conversion limits; it is not a precise crown-moss origin, complete range or direct ancestry claim.

description.en: Open the approximately 407 Ma Asteroxylon mackiei Rhynie-chert exemplar in the Lycophyta map to inspect its reconstructed leafy, root-bearing and rooting axes.
description.zh: 在石松类地图中打开约407 Ma莱尼燧石的Asteroxylon mackiei实例，检查其复原的具叶枝条、带根轴和生根轴。

limitations: The reconstruction is a species-level Rhynie-chert exemplar from Scotland; the 425–0 Ma clade envelope is rounded and does not establish a global lycophyte first appearance or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the rounded 385 Ma Middle Devonian Gilboa–Schoharie cladoxylopsid sample in the Pteridophyta map to inspect the attached Wattieza crown and Eospermatopteris trunk reconstruction.
description.zh: 在蕨类植物地图中打开约385 Ma中泥盆世Gilboa–Schoharie的枝蕨类样品，检查相连的Wattieza树冠与Eospermatopteris树干复原。

limitations: The rounded age belongs to the sampled cladoxylopsid reconstruction; its fern-like body plan is not a crown-fern, crown-horsetail or direct-ancestor claim.

title.zh: Metzgeriothallus sharonae地钱类植物体化石

description.en: Open the Givetian Metzgeriothallus sharonae body-fossil record from eastern New York in the Marchantiophyta map to inspect its thalloid gametophytes and associated sporophyte capsule.
description.zh: 在地钱类植物地图中打开来自纽约州东部的Givetian期Metzgeriothallus sharonae植物体化石记录，检查其叶状配子体与相关孢蒴。

limitations: The route is bounded to the Givetian eastern-New-York body-fossil record; it does not establish a crown-Marchantiophyta divergence date, global origin area or complete fossil distribution.

description.en: Open the 411.5 ± 1.3 Ma Rhynie-chert Aglaophyton major material in the map to inspect its decumbent axes, upright branches and terminal sporangia.
description.zh: 在地图中打开411.5 ± 1.3 Ma莱尼燧石Aglaophyton major材料，检查其匍匐轴、直立分枝与顶生孢子囊。

limitations: The 412.8–410.2 Ma interval is the U–Pb uncertainty window for represented Rhynie material, not a global Aglaophyton first appearance, last appearance or lineage duration.
